note: Fixed list of 25 landmarks written in session 1 (2026-11-07). Do not change without Gaspard's approval: it is the denominator of landmarks_detailed.

landmarks.name: King's College Chapel

landmarks.name: Senate House
landmarks.detail: Gibbs' Palladian hall: Corinthian pilasters, pediments, balustrade

landmarks.name: Great St Mary's, the University Church
landmarks.detail: West tower with corner pinnacles, clerestory windows

landmarks.name: Bridge of Sighs (St John's)
landmarks.detail: Covered neo-Gothic bridge with tracery windows over the Cam (man_made=bridge)

landmarks.name: Mathematical Bridge (Queens')
landmarks.detail: Timber tangent-and-radial truss footbridge (man_made=bridge)

landmarks.name: Fitzwilliam Museum
landmarks.detail: Neoclassical portico with Corinthian columns, pediment, dome

landmarks.name: Round Church (Holy Sepulchre)
landmarks.detail: Norman round nave with conical roof, round-arched windows

landmarks.name: Trinity College Great Gate
landmarks.detail: Tudor gate tower with four octagonal corner turrets (gate node node/443675369; part of the Great Court E-K range)

landmarks.name: Wren Library (Trinity)

landmarks.name: St John's College Chapel
landmarks.detail: Scott's chapel with tall square tower and pinnacles

landmarks.name: Gibbs' Building (King's)
landmarks.detail: Classical range with central arch and pediment

landmarks.name: The Old Schools

landmarks.name: Corn Exchange

landmarks.name: Pembroke College Chapel

landmarks.name: Peterhouse Chapel

landmarks.name: Little St Mary's Church

landmarks.name: St Bene't's Church

landmarks.name: Holy Trinity Church

landmarks.name: Pitt Building
